description: This source file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named TheorySet.aspx. It manages course and question set functionalities including course selection, question addition, and exam setup within an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks, dropdown changes, and database interactions for managing theory questions and courses.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: A code-behind class for the TheorySet.aspx page, handling user interactions, database operations related to course selection, question management, and exam setup within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented-out code related to session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel.aspx page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue.aspx page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard.aspx page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester with course options.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, updates question number, and notifies the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up a new exam for the selected course in the database and navigates to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Automatically updates the question number based on selected course questions count.
